name: @portfolio/design-tokens
description: Project-agnostic design-token engine: an authoring API (definePrimitives/defineContract/defineTheme/defineComponentTokens/defineComposite) plus a compiler (reference resolution, cycle detection, usage-graph promotion analysis, CSS/resolved-data serialization) and a custom ESLint rule set. Ships zero color/role names of its own — see README.md for how a project (e.g. frontend/src/shared/ui/theme/) supplies those and consumes this package.
